name: Black Gents
description: Black Gents was a party crew that operated in the LeClair Courts public housing projects in Chicago's Garfield Ridge neighborhood during the 1970s. The projects, built in 1950, were largely peaceful during this period and the Black Gents held a presence there until approximately 1979, when new Section 8 and prison release programs brought an influx of established People alliance gangs — including Conservative Vice Lords, Four Corner Hustlers, and Black P Stones — into the development.
